newsitem.title: USA: U.S. T-bond futures ease slightly after brief pop.
newsitem.headline: U.S. T-bond futures ease slightly after brief pop.

text.p: June 19 - U.S. Sept T-bond futures eased slightly after a brief pop higher on U.S. weekly jobless claims. Claims rose to 347,000 vs avg estimates of 333,000 and against 339,000 in prior week. Sept bonds' rally to 112-09/32 was short-lived.
U.S. trade deficit was smaller than expected in April.
